limits.generic_calls: explicit arguments or complete inference from call inputs; ambiguous and unmaterialized phantom arguments require explicit specialization
limits.unit: distinct no-value type; main returns i64; copied data, JSON and host/native invocation ABIs do not encode unit-containing signatures
limits.container_elements: buffers: storable copy/owned values without must-handle or external resource owners; pools: copyable elements; lists: copyable values without must-handle obligations; explicit storage excludes managed references
limits.native_runtime: JSON support linked through pinned Zig object; host effects require explicit ABI registration
limits.workers: host-facing copied typed messages; no guest spawn syntax
limits.floating_point: std_math::F64 nominal domain with named operations and bit codecs
limits.callbacks: generic signatures, exact effect ceilings, explicit readonly context borrows, no captures or reference results
limits.semantic_reuse: conservative function-body queries; generics constants aliases and inferred callback schemas check fresh
limits.text_data: byte offsets and ASCII trim; bounded decimal parser; fixed formatting 0..9 places
limits.hash_collections: fixed slot capacity; u64 or inline byte keys up to256bytes; copyable values
limits.time_random: Unix wall clock and explicit entropy capabilities; deterministic noncryptographic SplitMix64
limits.directory_listing: bounded immutable copied entries; unspecified order; no recursive walk
limits.managed_lists: copyable shared aliases; automatic growth; no owned/resource elements, borrowed interiors, untraced storage embedding, host escape or native emission
limits.gc: single-threaded nonmoving tracing; retained VM values root intermediates; collect-on-allocation stress option
